io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks

Class MultiBlockOwnership

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks.MultiBlockOwnership

  • public class MultiBlockOwnership
extends java.lang.Object
    Tracks which UUID owns each multiblock crafting table (Enhanced Crafting Table, Magic Workbench, Armor Forge), keyed by its dispenser Location. A multiblock is owned by the first player who interacts with it; ownership then gates the redstone auto-craft on the owner's unlocked research.

    This is a standalone side-store (a multiblock-owners.yml file) rather than a BlockStorage entry on purpose: the redstone listener identifies a multiblock dispenser precisely by it having no BlockStorage entry, so writing one would break auto-craft detection.

    The in-memory map is a ConcurrentHashMap and every mutation triggers a debounced async save, so it is safe to read/write from the main thread and to flush from an async task.

    • Method Detail

      • ownershipKey

        @Nonnull
public static org.bukkit.Location ownershipKey(@Nonnull
                                                        org.bukkit.block.Block center)
        The Location a multiblock's ownership is keyed by: its auto-craft dispenser when the structure has one, else the structure's own centre.
        Parameters:
        center - The block the structure matched on
        Returns:
        The location to key ownership by
        Implementation Note:
        Dispenser-keyed is the original scheme and stays so that existing multiblock-owners.yml entries and the redstone auto-craft lookup (which only ever knows the dispenser) keep working. Falling back to the centre is what lets a dispenser-less multiblock - the Automated Panning Machine and Table Saw in core - be owned at all; before this they were silently unownable and /sf owner always reported them free.
